name.zh: 艾伯塔省黄头公路 16 号

tagline.en: The Trans-Canada's northern branch, opened eight years after the main line
tagline.zh: 横加公路的北线支路，比主线晚八年通车

start.en: The Saskatchewan boundary east of Lloydminster
start.zh: 劳埃德明斯特以东的萨斯喀彻温省界

end.en: The British Columbia boundary at Yellowhead Pass, on the Continental Divide west of Jasper
end.zh: 贾斯珀以西大陆分水岭上的黄头山口，为不列颠哥伦比亚省界

en: The Yellowhead is the Trans-Canada Highway's second line across the west. It leaves the main route at Portage la Prairie in Manitoba and runs north-west through Saskatoon, Edmonton, Hinton and Jasper, crosses the Rockies at Yellowhead Pass, and carries on through Tête Jaune Cache and Prince George to reach the Pacific at Prince Rupert. Both branches carry the designation, and both are signed with the green shield.

The Alberta section is the busiest part of it, running the length of the province through Edmonton. West of the city it enters the foothills at Hinton and then Jasper National Park, where — as on Highway 1 through Banff — the road is federal rather than provincial, because Ottawa took on the national park sections in full under the 1949 Act.
Yellowhead Pass is the gentlest crossing of the Rockies on any Canadian highway, which is why the Grand Trunk Pacific Railway chose it and why the road followed.
zh: 黄头公路是横加公路横贯西部的第二条线。它自马尼托巴的波蒂奇拉普雷里离开主线，向西北经萨斯卡通、埃德蒙顿、欣顿与贾斯珀，在黄头山口翻越落基山，再经 Tête Jaune Cache 与乔治王子城，最终抵达太平洋岸的鲁珀特王子港。两条支线都承载该指定路线，也都挂绿色盾牌标志。
艾伯塔段是其中最繁忙的部分，纵贯全省并穿过埃德蒙顿。出城向西，它自欣顿进入山麓，随后进入贾斯珀国家公园——与班夫境内的 1 号公路一样，这段路归联邦而非省管，因为依 1949 年法案，渥太华全额承担了国家公园路段。
黄头山口是加拿大所有公路翻越落基山时最平缓的一处，大干线太平洋铁路当年选它，公路随后也就跟了过来。

en: The Yellowhead was officially opened in 1970, eight years after the ceremony at Rogers Pass and one year before construction under the Trans-Canada Highway Act finally ended.

It did not become one numbered road until later. The four western provinces agreed to carry it as Highway 16 throughout only in 1977–78; before that Saskatchewan's portions were Highways 5 and 14 and Manitoba's was PTH 4. Canada has no national numbering authority, so a single number across four provinces is something that has to be negotiated between them rather than assigned.
The route had an advocate long before it had a number. The Yellowhead Highway Association was founded in 1936, reformed in 1947, and renamed the Trans Canada Yellowhead Highway Association in 2000.
zh: 黄头公路于 1970 年正式通车，比罗杰斯山口的仪式晚八年，比《横加公路法》下建设的最终结束早一年。
它成为单一编号的一条路则更晚。西部四省直到 1977 至 1978 年才议定全线统一编为 16 号；在此之前，萨斯喀彻温段是 5 号与 14 号，马尼托巴段是 PTH 4。加拿大没有全国性的编号主管机构，因此一个编号要贯通四省，只能靠各省之间协商，而不是由上而下指派。
这条线路在有编号之前很久就已有人为它奔走。黄头公路协会成立于 1936 年，1947 年重组，2000 年更名为横加黄头公路协会。

value.en: No official figure. Transport Canada publishes none; the figures in circulation are 2,859 km, 2,991 km and 3,270 km, and they differ over the endpoints and over whether British Columbia's Highway 5 — named Yellowhead but not part of the designation — is counted.
value.zh: 无官方数据。加拿大交通部未发布任何数字；流传的说法有 2,859 公里、2,991 公里与 3,270 公里，分歧在于端点如何界定，以及是否计入不列颠哥伦比亚的 5 号公路——它虽名为黄头，却不属于该指定路线。

figures.source: Trans Canada Yellowhead Highway Association (3,270 km); transcanadahighway.com (2,991 km); the 2,859 km figure could not be traced to a published source

value.en: 1970, as a northern route across Western Canada
value.zh: 1970 年，作为横贯加拿大西部的北线通车

value.en: 1977–78, by agreement among the four western provinces; Saskatchewan's portions had been Highways 5 and 14 and Manitoba's PTH 4
value.zh: 1977 至 1978 年，由西部四省协商议定；此前萨斯喀彻温段为 5 号与 14 号，马尼托巴段为 PTH 4

figures.source: Recorded only in Wikipedia-family sources; the underlying provincial orders could not be reached

why.en: No public figure. The Yellowhead was built and extended by four provinces over decades, and no federal or provincial department has published a total for it.
why.zh: 无公开数据。黄头公路由四个省份历经数十年分别建设与延伸，联邦与各省均未发布过合计总额。

timeline.en: The Yellowhead Highway Association is founded to advocate for a northern route across the west.
timeline.zh: 黄头公路协会成立，倡议开辟一条横贯西部的北线。

timeline.en: The Yellowhead Highway is officially opened across Western Canada.
timeline.zh: 黄头公路在加拿大西部正式通车。

timeline.en: The four western provinces begin carrying the route as Highway 16 throughout.
timeline.zh: 西部四省开始将该线路全程编为 16 号公路。

timeline.en: The association is renamed the Trans Canada Yellowhead Highway Association.
timeline.zh: 该协会更名为横加黄头公路协会。
